data.one_liner: Wrapper to easily enable hot-reload for shelf applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper function to enable hot-reload for Dart shelf web applications. It hooks into the VM service to automatically restart the server when code changes occur.
use_when: You are developing a shelf backend application in Dart
You want to speed up your backend development workflow with hot-reload
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter frontend application
You are running in a production environment where VM service is disabled
strengths: Easy to set up with a single function call
Supports custom logging and lifecycle callbacks
weaknesses: Requires running the Dart application with the --enable-vm-service flag
Limited to shelf-based Dart backend applications
data.setup_notes: Run the application with the --enable-vm-service flag or use debug run in your IDE.
